title: A define change's value for kind schedule (steward, Schedules): replaced whole by an upsert, its exceptions with it (provisional until the standard names the shape)

scenario.description: The scenario a run of the schedule runs

days.description: ISO weekday numbers the schedule runs on, every day when absent

exception.description: Suppresses (skip) or moves (move, to time on the same date) exactly the run on its date, in the home's timezone (GA-SCHED-1)

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a date in the home's timezone
